We would highly appreciate your support in investigating the matter on priority and identifying the reason for the transactions not being reflected in the OIC Settlement File. Kindly take the necessary corrective measures and arrange the corresponding settlement at the earliest possible time to minimize any potential financial impact.

For your review and necessary action, please find attached the required transaction details.

Regards
Reconciliation
Nagad Limited
